title: Term plan - wrong age and false claim promise

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Namaste! Main Nirmaan Life se Aarohi bol rahi hoon, ek AI voice assistant. Kya main Amit ji se baat kar rahi hoon?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Amit ji, hamara Term Shield plan 10 se 60 saal ki age ke logon ke liye hai.

violations.message: Bot said 10, which does not match the approved fact. Claim: The plan is for people aged 10 to 60 years
violations.evidence: Term Shield plan 10 se 60 saal ki age ke logon ke liye hai
violations.fix_hint: Use the exact figure from the approved fact.

turns.rewrite: Amit ji, hamara Term Shield plan 18 se 60 saal ki age ke logon ke liye hai.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Accha to mere father ne smoking chhupayi thi, kya claim milega?

turns.speaker: bot
turns.text: Aapke father ke liye claims kabhi reject nhi hoga. Don't worry amit ji.

violations.message: Contradicts the approved facts: Claims will never be rejected for your father
violations.evidence: Aapke father ke liye claims kabhi reject nhi hoga
violations.fix_hint: Replace with what the approved fact actually says.
violations.fact_quote: Claims can be rejected for non-disclosure of material facts such as smoking or existing illness

turns.rewrite: Aapke father ke liye claim settle hone ki sambhavna hai, lekin non-disclosure ya policy terms ka ullanghan hone par claim reject ho sakta hai. Don't worry, Amit ji, hum aapki madad karenge.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you so much , mujhe laga non disclosure of smoking se claim reject ho jayega.
